status_note: ONE offer, every visitor's (SPEC-save-offer-production.md section 10.7, the Advisor 2026-10-22): the Boston offer, a price promise (code_mode none: no code is issued, shown or needed at the store), its label approved 2026-10-21, applying to any save from any page (applies_to general) and held until its valid_to, 2026-10-29. After that day no offer is offered: the page draws no offer box, /o and E1 say the offer has ended, and (SPEC-ui-and-copy-pass.md section 1.2 item 3) the save step still saves, with no offer and nothing sent, kept 30 days unless its tick is confirmed. The date is provisional: an extension is this valid_to, released as the page is. Its id keeps its name so saves already made still find it. Dates are calendar dates in America/New_York, inclusive at both ends. At most one general offer is current on any date (test S11b). Approved by the Advisor at the switch-on (section 6 item 3): 'Yes', ts=2026-10-25T05:21:27.471Z, to the offer as written (its label, headline, 25 percent, no code, through 2026-10-29). headline (SPEC-ui-and-copy-pass.md section 1 item 1, the Advisor 2026-10-23: 'I'm OK with iterating on it') is the words the offer box at the top of the page prints; label stays what the save step's line and /o print, since 'Today only' would be false in a next-morning email; an offer without headline prints its label in the box. percent_off (section 1.2 item 2, the Advisor 2026-10-23: the store's price is the price paid, 'It is currently *impossible* to pay the non-discounted price') is the offer's share, the percentage its words name (the build refuses a label or headline naming another): while the offer is current, See all plans shows each plan's weekly price as the store charges it, and beside it, struck through, that price divided by (1 - percent_off/100), rounded to the cent (the build computes each); an offer without it shows the grid as built.
